findings.passage: I strongly support the Second Amendment, and any firearm policy must respect those freedoms while focusing on keeping guns out of the hands of people who pose a danger.
findings.note: Legislative update from the member's House news page: general statement on gun rights, with limits aimed at dangerous people.

findings.passage: The reality is that Minnesota already has red flag laws, universal background checks, and restrictions on straw purchasers. Yet violence persists. The hard truth is no single gun law will solve this problem.
findings.note: Same update: describes existing red-flag, background-check and straw-purchase laws and says no single gun law will fix violence; favors prevention and early intervention.

findings.passage: We’ve heard him and DFL leaders express their desire to bring forward an assault weapons ban and a high-capacity magazine ban. I’ve been equally clear that any special session must focus on keeping students safe, expanding access to mental health care, and ensuring criminals face real consequences.
findings.note: Same update: on a possible special session, he says it should focus on school safety, mental health and penalties rather than the proposed assault-weapon and magazine bans.
subjects: ban on assault-style guns and large magazines

findings.passage: I have zero sympathy for criminals and fully support mandatory minimum sentences for gun crimes.
findings.note: Same update: supports mandatory minimum sentences for gun crimes.

findings.passage: “The warning signs are often there,” Bakeberg said. “The challenge is making sure we have systems in place to act before it’s too late.”
findings.note: Caucus news release quoting him on the Safer Communities Together Initiative, a prevention plan that also lists tougher penalties for straw purchasers and required firearm storage away from prohibited persons.

findings.passage: I also want to be clear on an important point: I will not support a blanket ban on firearms that limits the ability of law-abiding individuals to protect themselves and their families. At the same time, I have supported, and will continue to support, laws that prevent criminals from accessing firearms.
findings.note: Legislative update from his House news page: opposes a blanket firearm ban, supports laws keeping criminals from getting guns.
subjects: ban on assault-style guns and large magazines

findings.passage: And I have supported gun safety proposals that keep weapons out of the hands of individuals who should not have them.
findings.note: Same update: says he has backed gun safety proposals that keep guns from people who should not have them.

subjects: ban on assault-style guns and large magazines
